words.definition: v. 攀爬；争夺；炒（蛋）；打乱 n. 争夺；爬

examples.en: Fans scrambled for tickets the moment they went on sale.
examples.zh: 门票一开售，歌迷们就争相抢购。

examples.en: The children scrambled up the rocky hillside.
examples.zh: 孩子们手脚并用爬上石坡。

words.usage: scramble for/over（争夺）；scrambled eggs（炒蛋）；scramble up/over（攀爬）；scrambled message（乱码）技术义。与 struggle（挣扎）、scrabble（摸索）辨析。
words.mnemonic: scr+amble 像螃蟹乱爬 → 攀爬；争抢

words.definition: n. 螺丝（钉） v. 用螺丝拧紧；拧，旋

examples.en: He tightened the screws with a screwdriver.
examples.zh: 他用螺丝刀把螺丝拧紧。

examples.en: Screw the lid back on the jar.
examples.zh: 把盖子重新拧回罐子上。

words.usage: 搭配 screw in/out（拧入/拧出）；习语 have one's head screwed on（头脑冷静）与 screw up（搞砸；拧紧）口语高频。复数 screws；screwdriver 螺丝刀。
collocations: tighten a screw 拧紧螺丝
words.mnemonic: scr 一拧就转圈 → 螺丝

words.definition: n. 失误，小错；（时间）流逝；中止 v. 失效；中止

examples.en: A momentary lapse of concentration caused the accident.
examples.zh: 瞬间的注意力疏忽导致了事故。

examples.en: His insurance policy lapsed last month.
examples.zh: 他的保险单上个月失效了。

words.usage: a lapse of memory/concentration（记忆/注意力的失误）；time lapse（时间流逝）；契约类失效：subscription lapsed。形容词 collapsed 同根 labi（滑落）。relapse（旧病复发）同族。
collocations: a lapse of memory 记忆失误
words.mnemonic: slip 滑了一下 → 小失误；流逝

words.definition: n. 人类

examples.en: The moon landing was a great achievement for mankind.
examples.zh: 登月是人类的一项伟大成就。

examples.en: Disease has threatened mankind throughout history.
examples.zh: 疾病在历史上一直威胁着人类。

words.usage: 不可数，正式/书面语；the future of mankind（人类的未来）。现代英语倾向用 humanity 或 humankind（避免性别指向）。同义词族：human race。
collocations: the future of mankind 人类的未来
words.mnemonic: man(人)+kind(类)→ 人这一类 → 人类

words.definition: n. 障碍（物），妨碍

examples.en: Fear of failure is the biggest obstacle to success.
examples.zh: 对失败的恐惧是成功最大的障碍。

examples.en: The fallen tree was an obstacle on the road.
examples.zh: 倒下的树是路上的障碍物。

words.usage: obstacle to sth（…的障碍）介词搭配高频；overcome/clear/remove obstacles（克服障碍）。动词 obstruct（阻塞）同根（ob- 逆 + sta 站 → 挡路站前）。
collocations: obstacle to progress 进步的障碍
words.mnemonic: ob(逆)+sta(站)→ 挡在站前 → 障碍

words.definition: n. 碎片，残余；废料；少量 v. 废弃，抛弃

examples.en: The plan was scrapped due to lack of funds.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金，该计划被废弃了。

examples.en: He wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
examples.zh: 他把地址写在一张纸片上。

words.usage: a scrap of paper（一张纸片）；scrap metal/food（废金属/剩饭）；动词 scrap a plan（废弃计划）新闻高频；have a scrap（口角）口语。与 scrape（刮擦）形近音近必辨。
collocations: a scrap of paper 一张纸片
scrap the plan 废弃计划
words.mnemonic: scr 刮下来的小片 → 碎片；废料

words.definition: v. 刮，擦；擦伤 n. 刮擦声；擦伤；窘境

examples.en: She scraped the paint off the door.
examples.zh: 她把门上的漆刮掉了。

examples.en: He got into a scrape on his knee during the fall.
examples.zh: 摔倒时他膝盖被擦伤了。

words.usage: scrape sth off/from（从…刮掉）；scrape through（勉强通过，考试高频习语）；get into a scrape（陷入窘境）。与 scrap（碎片·废弃）音近形近必辨。
collocations: a scrape on the knee 膝盖擦伤
words.mnemonic: 刀贴面一刮 → scrape，刮

words.definition: n. 电报；电报机 v. 发电报；流露（意图）

examples.en: In the 19th century, news travelled by telegraph.
examples.zh: 十九世纪，消息靠电报传递。

examples.en: His expression telegraphed his disappointment.
examples.zh: 他的表情流露出了失望。

words.usage: by telegraph（用电报）；动词比喻义「不经意暴露」：telegraph one's intentions（暴露意图）。词根 tele-（远）+ graph（写）。telegram 指电报文稿，telegraph 指系统/手段。
collocations: telegraph one's intentions 暴露意图
words.mnemonic: tele(远)+graph(写)→ 远方写字 → 电报

words.definition: n. 速度，速率

examples.en: The train reached a velocity of 300 kilometres per hour.
examples.zh: 列车时速达到了 300 公里。

examples.en: Escape velocity is the speed needed to leave Earth's gravity.
examples.zh: 逃逸速度是脱离地球引力所需的速度。

words.usage: 科技书面语，与 speed 之别：velocity 有方向（矢量），speed 无方向（标量）。escape velocity（逃逸速度）、high velocity（高速）高频。复数 velocities。
words.mnemonic: veloc(快)+ity → 快的程度 → 速度

words.definition: n. 气味（美式拼写；英式 odour）

examples.en: A strange odor was coming from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里飘来一股奇怪的气味。

examples.en: The scandal left a lingering odor of corruption.
examples.zh: 丑闻留下了挥之不去的腐败恶名。

words.usage: 美式拼 odor，英式 odour；中性词，bad odor（恶臭；坏名声）。同族 scent（香味）、stink/stench（恶臭）、aroma（芳香）。形容词 odorless 无味的。
collocations: in bad odor with 名声不佳
a strange odor 奇怪的气味
words.mnemonic: 鼻子 oh 一声 → 闻到气味

words.definition: n. 望远镜 v.（叠缩）压缩

examples.en: Galileo pointed his telescope at the night sky.
examples.zh: 伽利略把望远镜指向夜空。

examples.en: Two weeks of work were telescoped into three days.
examples.zh: 两周的工作被压缩到三天完成。

words.usage: tele-（远）+ scope（镜，观察）；through a telescope（通过望远镜）；动词比喻「压缩、叠缩」。同族 microscope 显微镜、periscope 潜望镜。
collocations: look through a telescope 透过望远镜看
words.mnemonic: tele(远)+scope(镜)→ 看远之镜

words.definition: n. 边缘，边界 v. 接近，濒临

examples.en: The company is on the verge of bankruptcy.
examples.zh: 公司濒临破产。

examples.en: His behaviour verges on madness.
examples.zh: 他的行为近乎疯狂。

words.usage: on the verge of（濒于，几近）高频；verge on sth（接近，近乎）。与 edge（边）、brink（危机边缘）辨析：verge 多与抽象临界搭配。
collocations: on the verge of 濒于
words.mnemonic: verge 逼近终点线 → 边缘

words.definition: n. 剧本，脚本；笔迹；字母表

examples.en: The actors spent a week rehearsing from the script.
examples.zh: 演员们照剧本排练了一周。

examples.en: Arabic is written in a flowing script.
examples.zh: 阿拉伯语用流畅的字母体系书写。

words.usage: film script（电影剧本）；script writer 编剧；同根形近族：manuscript 手稿、transcript 转录本、prescription 处方；描述文字：the Cyrillic script 西里尔字母。

confusables.note: scribble 潦草书写，scrib- 同根

collocations: follow the script 照本宣科
read from the script 照剧本念
words.mnemonic: scr(写)+ipt → 写下的本子 → 剧本

words.definition: n. 踏板 v. 踩踏板；骑车

examples.en: Press the brake pedal gently to slow down.
examples.zh: 轻踩刹车踏板减速。

examples.en: She pedalled hard up the hill.
examples.zh: 她用力蹬车上坡。

words.usage: brake/accelerator pedal（刹车/油门踏板）；pedal a bike（蹬自行车）；过去式英式 pedalled。形近三兄弟：pedal 踏板、peddle 叫卖、pedlar 小贩。
collocations: pedal a bike 蹬自行车
words.mnemonic: ped(脚)+al → 用脚踩的 → 踏板

words.definition: adj. 乏味的，冗长无聊的

examples.en: The lecture was so tedious that half the audience dozed off.
examples.zh: 讲座乏味得一半听众都打起了瞌睡。

examples.en: Data entry is tedious but necessary work.
examples.zh: 数据录入枯燥却是必要的工作。

words.usage: tedious task/job/meeting（乏味的任务/工作/会议）；tedium n. 单调乏味。近义链：boring（通用）→ dull（沉闷）→ tedious（冗长令人生厌，书面）。

confusables.note: tenuous 脆弱·空洞，te- 同头

collocations: long and tedious 冗长乏味
words.mnemonic: tedium 太长就 tedious → 乏味

words.definition: n. 手稿，原稿；（书）底稿

examples.en: The author submitted her manuscript to three publishers.
examples.zh: 作者把手稿投给了三家出版社。

examples.en: A priceless medieval manuscript was discovered in the library.
examples.zh: 图书馆里发现了一份价值连城的中世纪手稿。

words.usage: manu（手）+ script（写）→ 手写之稿；submit a manuscript（投递稿件）出版高频；manuscript collection 手稿集。与 script、transcript、inscription 同根族。
collocations: submit a manuscript 提交手稿
words.mnemonic: manu(手)+script(写)→ 手写稿

words.definition: v. 训斥，责骂

examples.en: His mother scolded him for breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 他因打碎花瓶被母亲训斥。

examples.en: The teacher scolded the boy for being late again.
examples.zh: 老师责骂那男孩又迟到了。

words.usage: scold sb for sth（因某事责骂某人）固定搭配；语气比 criticize 重、比 curse 轻，多指长辈训晚辈。名词 scolding 一顿训斥。
collocations: scold sb for sth 因某事责骂
words.mnemonic: s+cold → 骂得人心里发冷 → 训斥

words.definition: n. 雕塑，雕刻（品） v. 雕刻

examples.en: The park displays modern sculptures by local artists.
examples.zh: 公园里陈列着本地艺术家的现代雕塑。

examples.en: The figure was sculptured from white marble.
examples.zh: 这座人像由白色大理石雕成。

words.usage: a sculpture of sb（某人的雕像）；动词 sculpture/carve；sculptor n. 雕塑家（注意 -or）；sculptural adj. 雕塑的。词根 sculp（刻）。
collocations: a sculpture of sb 某人雕像
words.mnemonic: sculp(刻)+ture → 刻出来的作品 → 雕塑

words.definition: adj. 帝国的，皇帝的；专横的

examples.en: The imperial palace dates back to the Ming dynasty.
examples.zh: 这座皇宫可追溯到明代。

examples.en: Britain's imperial ambitions shaped its foreign policy.
examples.zh: 英国的帝国野心塑造了其外交政策。

words.usage: imperial palace/family/power（皇宫/皇室/帝国强权）高频；imperialism n. 帝国主义；imperious（专横的，义近易混）；与 impérial 重音在 -pe-。
words.mnemonic: empire（帝国）的形容词 → 帝国的

words.definition: n. 静脉；矿脉；纹理；气质

examples.en: Blood was taken from a vein in her arm.
examples.zh: 血从她手臂的静脉中抽取。

examples.en: The rock is rich in gold-bearing veins.
examples.zh: 这块岩石富含金矿脉。

words.usage: 静脉义医学高频；矿脉、叶脉、纹理引申；a vein of humour（幽默的气质）。同音形近：vein/vain（徒劳的）/vane（风向标）三兄弟。

confusables.note: vain 徒劳的·自负的，同音

collocations: vein and artery 静脉与动脉
in a serious vein 以严肃的口吻
words.mnemonic: 身体里送血回心的路 → 静脉
